categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Zhengguang Industrial Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of ion exchange and adsorption resins. Their products serve multiple sectors including industrial water treatment, food and drinking water, nuclear industry, electronics, new energy, biomedicine, environmental protection, and hydrometallurgy. The company also focuses on expanding applications in emerging fields such as lithium extraction, semiconductor ultra-pure water, and biopharmaceuticals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes proprietary polymerization and functional group reaction technologies to produce various types of ion exchange and adsorption resins. Key production stages include polymerization, functionalization, and purification. They employ advanced Distributed Control Systems (DCS) for automated production control, ensuring product consistency. The company holds multiple patents and has developed core technologies for nuclear-grade resins, powder resins, uniform particle resins, polishing resins, and biopharmaceutical resins.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Zhejiang Zhengguang serves a diversified customer base including large domestic and international enterprises such as Germany's BRITA, Japan's Mitsubishi Chemical, Swiss AQUIS, and major Chinese corporations like Sinopec and China National Nuclear Corporation. Their products cater to industries requiring high-purity separation and purification materials, including power generation, food and beverage, nuclear power, electronics, biomedicine, environmental protection, and new energy sectors. The company exports to countries including Germany, Switzerland, Russia, Italy, South Korea, the USA, and regions in Africa.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing and R&D facilities in Zhejiang Province (Hangzhou, Ningbo) and Hubei Province (Jingmen, Wuhan). It also has a manufacturing presence in Thailand. Its sales cover domestic markets extensively and international markets including Europe, North America, and Asia, with exports accounting for approximately 24.5% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Zhengguang operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of ion exchange and adsorption resins from petrochemical raw materials such as styrene and divinylbenzene. It sources raw materials from upstream petrochemical suppliers and supplies finished resin products downstream to industrial users and manufacturers in various sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and product development, investing over 5% of its revenue in R&D. Strategic R&D directions include developing lithium adsorption materials for new energy, electronic-grade resins for semiconductor ultra-pure water, CO2 adsorption resins for environmental applications, and biopharmaceutical resins. It emphasizes import substitution to replace foreign high-end resin products and collaborates with universities and research institutes to enhance innovation capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of ion exchange and adsorption resin products. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distributors and agents. Revenue recognition occurs at the point of product delivery and customer acceptance, with contracts typically specifying product transfer and payment terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with multinational corporations such as Dow Chemical (USA), Lanxess (Germany), Purolite (UK), and Mitsubishi Chemical (Japan) in the high-end resin market. Zhejiang Zhengguang is recognized as a leading domestic manufacturer with capabilities in producing nuclear-grade and specialty resins, progressively achieving import substitution and expanding market share in China and abroad. It holds significant influence in industry standard setting and is acknowledged as a national champion in specialized manufacturing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 572 million, representing an 8.67% increase from the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 103 million, a slight decrease of 5.33%. Total assets reached RMB 2.21 billion, up 8.38% year-over-year. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by expanding production capacity and continuous R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Zhengguang emphasizes high-quality, high-performance ion exchange and adsorption resins with a broad product portfolio covering over 400 models across 20 series. Its products offer superior separation, purification, and adsorption capabilities, tailored for diverse and demanding industrial applications. The company differentiates itself through proprietary technologies, comprehensive quality certifications (including FDA, NSF, HALAL, and nuclear industry qualifications), strong R&D capabilities, and extensive customer service and technical support, enabling it to meet stringent customer requirements and replace imported products.
